name: GATE
conducting_body: IISc + IITs for NCB-GATE, Ministry of Education
used_for: M.Tech/ME, MS(R), PhD in India; PSU recruitment
pattern: Computer-based; 30 papers incl. new Robotics and Automation; one or two papers from allowed combinations; English only. Duration 3 h, MCQ/MSQ/NAT (verify)
sections: 100 marks per paper; General Aptitude 15 marks

name: CAT
used_for: IIM and most Indian MBA admissions
pattern: 3 sections: VARC, DILR, QA; 40 min each, 120 min; expected 68 questions (24/22/22), 204 marks
marking_scheme: +3 correct, -1 wrong MCQ, no penalty on TITA
eligibility: Bachelor's with 50% (45% SC/ST); final-year students allowed

name: XAT
pattern: 3 h in two parts. Part 1 (170 min): Verbal and Logical Reasoning, Decision-Making, Quant and DI. Part 2 (10 min): GK

name: GRE General
pattern: About 1 h 58 min: Analytical Writing (1 Issue task, 30 min); Verbal 12 Q/18 min + 15 Q/23 min; Quant 12 Q/21 min + 15 Q/26 min

name: GMAT Focus
used_for: MBA abroad, ISB, some Indian programmes
pattern: Quantitative Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning, Data Insights; about 2 h 15 min, 64 questions (verify)

name: TOEFL iBT
pattern: Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing; new format from 21 Jan 2026
score_scale: 1-6 in half bands (CEFR-aligned); 0-120 equivalent shown until Jan 2028 (5.0 ~ 95+, 5.5 ~ 107+)

name: IELTS Academic
used_for: English proficiency, esp. UK, Canada, Australia, Europe
pattern: Listening ~30 min, Reading 60, Writing 60, Speaking 11-14; 2 h 45 min; centre or online
